IncidentDef.label: a span down on the line

texts.li: [span] A line-runner of {FACTION} has come from the relay at {PLACE} with a letter from {DEAD}, its relay-keeper: a storm brought a span of the line down, and the masts beyond it have gone quiet. They ask the colony for machine parts by a set day, and the Line pays well for anything that keeps a mast singing.

[guy] {DEAD}, relay-keeper at {PLACE}, sends a line-runner of {FACTION}: the wind tore the guy wires off the big mast, and it will come down with the next storm unless it is braced. They ask the colony for steel by a set day, at a good price.
[span,their:friend] The Signal Line has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. A span is down at {PLACE}, and {DEAD} would rather buy the colony's parts than anyone's.

li.label: Accept the terms
li.outcome: The line-runner went back to {PLACE} to tell {DEAD} the colony will have it ready.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will mend the span with what they have, and the masts beyond it will stay quiet a while longer.

terms.li: {FACTION} are asking for {ITEM}, in the colony's stockpiles by the day the Quests tab shows, when the Line's runners come for it.\n\nAll of it fetches {COUNT} silver, well over its worth. At least half, and they'll take what there is at its plain worth. Less, and the masts beyond {PLACE} stay quiet, and the Line says where it heard who promised.

accepted.li: The colony will have {ITEM} ready for the Line's relay at {PLACE}, in the stockpiles for {FACTION}'s runners.

ready.li: The goods for {PLACE} are set aside, and {FACTION}'s runners are on their way for them.

reminder.li: {FACTION}'s runners come soon from the relay, and the stockpiles are still short: {ITEM}.

done.li: [delivered] {FACTION}'s runners are coming for the colony's goods, with {ITEM} silver for them. The masts beyond {PLACE} will be singing again before long.
[partial] Only part of it is ready. {FACTION}'s runners are coming for what there is, with its plain worth, {ITEM} silver.

fail.li: [missed] There was far too little ready for {FACTION}'s runners to be worth the road. The masts beyond {PLACE} stay quiet, and {DEAD} knows who said they would help.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} have broken with the colony, and their runners will not come.
The relay at {PLACE} is gone, and nobody is left there to send for the goods.

texts.li: [shift] A pit-runner of {FACTION} has come from the pit at {PLACE} with a letter from its shift-captain: a seam opened faster than the union can work it, and half the shift is down with the cough. They ask the colony for two good miners for a day and a half underground, paid by the shift, as the union pays.

[shift,their:lowtech] A runner with the union's red armband has walked from {PLACE} to ask the colony for two who know a pick. The face is open and the union is short, the runner says, and everyone comes up at the end of the shift.
[shift,their:friend] The Deepwell Union has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The pit at {PLACE} is two hands short on a rich seam, and the shift-captain would rather they were the colony's.

li.label: Send miners to {PLACE}
li.outcome: The runner went back to the pit to say the colony's miners are coming.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will work the seam with the hands they have.

terms.li: At least two of the colony's good miners (Mining 6 or more), at the union's pit at {PLACE} by caravan (about {TALE} away), staying about a day and a half at the face. The caravan only needs to reach the pit and wait there.\n\nThey'll come home with about {COUNT} silver and a gift of the pit's, paid by the shift, and {FACTION} will write the colony's miners in the union's book. Half the stay earns half the silver.

accepted.li: The colony will send miners to {PLACE}. Form a caravan with at least two good miners, and send it to the pit.

ready.li: The colony's miners have reached the pit at {PLACE} and gone down with the shift. Keep the caravan there while the seam is worked.

reminder.li: The union's pit at {PLACE} is still short, and the colony's miners haven't come.

done.li: [worked] Everyone is up at the end of the shift, and the colony's miners are coming home from {PLACE} with silver and a gift of the pit's. Their names are in the union's book.
[partial] The colony's miners had to come up before the seam was worked. {FACTION} paid them for the hours they put in, by the shift.

fail.li: [missed] No miners came from the colony, and the seam at {PLACE} went unworked. {FACTION} put it to the vote, and nobody voted for the colony.

cancelled.li: The pit at {PLACE} no longer needs the colony: the pit, or the friendship, is gone.

titles.li: The Republic counts its votes at {PLACE}

texts.li: [count] A dispatch rider of {FACTION} has come from the town hall at {PLACE} with a letter from its minister: the Republic holds its election, and the law asks for a witness from outside the Republic at the count, someone the region trusts. They ask the colony for one of its people good with words to sit through the count for a day.

[count,their:lowtech] A rider of the Republic has come from {PLACE}: the Republic is choosing its leaders by vote, and wants an outsider to watch every vote counted, as its old law says. One of the colony's people good with words would do.
[count,their:friend] The Last Republic has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The count at {PLACE} needs a witness the region trusts, and the minister would rather it were the colony's.

li.label: Send a witness to {PLACE}
li.outcome: The rider went back to the town hall to say the colony's witness is coming.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will count without a witness, and say so on the radio.

terms.li: One of the colony's good talkers (Social 6 or more), at the Republic's town hall at {PLACE} by caravan (about {TALE} away), staying a day to watch the count. The caravan only needs to reach the town and wait there.\n\nThey'll come home with about {COUNT} silver and a gift of the town's, and {FACTION} will write the colony's name in the record of the election as its witness. Half the stay earns half the silver.

accepted.li: The colony will send a witness to {PLACE}. Form a caravan with a good talker, and send it to the town.

ready.li: The colony's witness has reached the town hall at {PLACE} and taken a seat by the ballot boxes. Keep the caravan there while the votes are counted.

reminder.li: The count at {PLACE} is waiting for its witness, and the colony's hasn't come.

done.li: [worked] Every vote is counted twice, as the law says, and the colony's witness is coming home from {PLACE} with silver and a gift of the town's. The colony's name is in the record of the election.
[partial] The colony's witness had to leave before the count was done. {FACTION} paid for the hours they sat, and wrote down that they left.

fail.li: [missed] No witness came from the colony, and the count at {PLACE} went on without one. {FACTION} said so on the radio, by name.

cancelled.li: The count at {PLACE} no longer needs the colony: the town, or the friendship, is gone.

texts.li: [plating] A deck-runner of {FACTION} has come from the hull at {PLACE} with a letter from {DEAD}, its first officer: the engineers have found a breach in the hull they can close, if they have the plasteel for it, and every breach closed is a step toward the day the ship lifts. They ask the colony for plasteel by a set day, and will pay well.

[parts] {DEAD}, first officer at {PLACE}, sends a deck-runner of {FACTION}: one of the ship's old systems has woken and wants parts the hull no longer makes. They ask the colony for machine parts by a set day, at a good price.
[plating,their:friend] The Hollow Fleet has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The hull at {PLACE} needs plating, and {DEAD} would rather it came from the colony than anyone.

li.label: Accept the terms
li.outcome: The deck-runner went back to {PLACE} to log that the colony will have it ready.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} log the answer, and the breach in the hull stays open a while longer.

terms.li: {FACTION} are asking for {ITEM}, in the colony's stockpiles by the day the Quests tab shows, when the ship's runners come for it.\n\nAll of it fetches {COUNT} silver, well over its worth. At least half, and they'll take what there is at its plain worth. Less, and the hull at {PLACE} waits, and the ship's log will say who said they would help.

accepted.li: The colony will have {ITEM} ready for the hull at {PLACE}, in the stockpiles for {FACTION}'s runners.

ready.li: The goods for {PLACE} are set aside, and {FACTION}'s runners are on their way for them.

reminder.li: {FACTION}'s runners come soon from the hull, and the stockpiles are still short: {ITEM}.

done.li: [delivered] {FACTION}'s runners are coming for the colony's goods, with {ITEM} silver for them. The ship's log says one breach fewer.
[partial] Only part of it is ready. {FACTION}'s runners are coming for what there is, with its plain worth, {ITEM} silver.

fail.li: [missed] There was far too little ready for {FACTION}'s runners to be worth the road. The hull at {PLACE} waits, and {DEAD} has logged who said they would help.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} have broken with the colony, and their runners will not come.
The hull at {PLACE} is gone, and nobody is left there to send for the goods.
